job.title: ADC Engineer I, Amazon Dedicated Cloud Engineering - Support Engineering
job.location: Arlington, VA · Herndon, VA · Jessup, MD
job.pay_full: $91,000 – $152,000 a year base salary (Arlington VA, Herndon VA and Jessup MD), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon Web Services runs cloud infrastructure for some of the most demanding workloads in the US Intelligence Community, and its ADC Engineering team keeps that infrastructure running around the clock. As an ADC Engineer I you operate and maintain large-scale distributed cloud systems behind classified missions: watching their health, responding to operational events and running runbooks. It is hands-on from day one, building a strong base in Linux, networking and AWS alongside experienced engineers.
duties: Monitor and maintain the health of large-scale distributed cloud infrastructure supporting classified customer workloads
Run defined operational runbooks and tasks on schedule
Troubleshoot issues across Linux, networking and AWS cloud services, resolving or escalating them before customers are affected
Flag defects and availability, performance or maintainability concerns to senior engineers
Recommend process improvements that cut operational toil and strengthen reliability
Assess operational risk in real time in live production environments
Document findings, incident timelines and remediation steps for the team
needs: High school or equivalent diploma, or an A+, CND (Certified Network Defender), Network+ or Security+ certification
1+ years of networking experience (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, the OSI model and TCP/IP)
3+ years of technical troubleshooting or similar experience
1–3 years of Linux/Unix systems administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, RedHat, Solaris, etc.)
A current, active TS/SCI US Government security clearance with polygraph
nice: Internet fundamentals and cloud computing concepts
AWS core services, console or command line interface
IPsec, VPN, load balancing, routing protocols, SSH and network monitoring/troubleshooting tools; managing full application stacks from the OS up
details.benefits: Base salary $91,000 – $152,000 a year (Arlington VA, Herndon VA and Jessup MD). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Shift work: the team runs 24/7 operations and some nights and/or weekends may be required
After starting, you must obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph (or equivalent) for each government agency you support
Amazon encourages people whose careers are just starting, or who took a non-traditional path, to apply
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
